say:3:1741116002:1.text: Of course I do. I was the model.
say:3:1741116002:1.source_cn: 那当然了，毕竟本狐是它的原型嘛。

say:4:1741116003:1.text: Though saying I look exactly like it is a little unfair.
say:4:1741116003:1.source_cn: 不过一模一样是不是有点夸张了？
say:4:1741116003:1.male: Though saying I look exactly like it is a little unfair.
say:4:1741116003:1.female: Though saying I look exactly like it is a little unfair.

say:5:1741116004:1.text: My fur is naturally soft and glossy. That rough little toy could never capture even a fraction of my charm.
say:5:1741116004:1.source_cn: 本狐的毛发可是自带柔顺光泽的，那种粗糙的布料怎么可能还...
say:5:1741116004:1.male: My fur is naturally soft and glossy. That rough little toy could never capture even a fraction of my charm.
say:5:1741116004:1.female: My fur is naturally soft and glossy. That rough little toy could never capture even a fraction of my charm.

say:6:1741116005:1.text: And the eyes? Well, you can use the shiniest gems you want, but you can't put this much personality in a toy!
say:6:1741116005:1.source_cn: 眼珠也是……就算用上黑曜石，也还原不出我灵动的眼神吧！
say:6:1741116005:1.male: And the eyes? Well, you can use the shiniest gems you want, but you can't put this much personality in a toy!

say:8:1741116006:1.source_cn: 能有什么了不得的好处……

say:9:1741116008:1.text: I was napping in the Consortium warehouse when some designer burst in, took one look at me, and started sketching like his life depended on it.
say:9:1741116008:1.source_cn: 那天我正在秘银商会的仓库里睡午觉呢，一个设计师小子突然...
say:9:1741116008:1.male: I was napping in the Consortium warehouse when some designer burst in, took one look at me, and started sketching like his life depended on it.
say:9:1741116008:1.female: I was napping in the Consortium warehouse when some designer burst in, took one look at me, and started sketching like his life depended on it.

say:10:1741116009:1.text: I thought he was a creep and was about to bite him. Then he pulled out a plate of premium roasted drumsticks...
say:10:1741116009:1.source_cn: 本狐还以为他是变态，刚想咬他一口，他就拿出一盘顶级的烤...
say:10:1741116009:1.male: I thought he was a creep and was about to bite him. Then he pulled out a plate of premium roasted drumsticks...
say:10:1741116009:1.female: I thought he was a creep and was about to bite him. Then he pulled out a plate of premium roasted drumsticks...

say:11:1741116010:1.text: Ahem! I mean, he made a very moving case for his artistic vision.
say:11:1741116010:1.source_cn: 咳！我是说，他诚恳地向我阐述了艺术创作的理念。
say:11:1741116010:1.male: Ahem! I mean, he made a very moving case for his artistic vision.
say:11:1741116010:1.female: Ahem! I mean, he made a very moving case for his artistic vision.

say:12:1741116011:1.text: He said I had the perfect mix of charm, wit, and sparkle, and that keeping all this from the world would be a crime against Savannah!
say:12:1741116011:1.source_cn: 他说我的形象代表了智慧与灵动，如果不做成玩偶让世人瞻仰...
say:12:1741116011:1.male: He said I had the perfect mix of charm, wit, and sparkle, and that keeping all this from the world would be a crime against Savannah!
say:12:1741116011:1.female: He said I had the perfect mix of charm, wit, and sparkle, and that keeping all this from the world would be a crime against Savannah!

say:13:1741116012:1.text: Since he clearly had good taste, I let him make a few sketches. Then the Consortium went and made thousands of them!
say:13:1741116012:1.source_cn: 本狐一想，既然他这么有眼光，那就勉为其难让他画几张吧。...

say:15:1741116013:1.text: The children love them, so I'll let the royalty problem slide. For now.
say:15:1741116013:1.source_cn: 看在那些小孩那么喜欢我的份上，我就不跟秘银商会计较版权费了。

say:15:1741116013:1.female: The children love them, so I'll let the royalty problem slide. For now.

say:16:1741116014:1.text: But honestly, they should've made the tail bigger. My tail is one of my best features, and the toy's doesn't do it justice!
say:16:1741116014:1.source_cn: 不过说真的，那个玩偶的尾巴要是能再做大一点就好了，本狐...
